page_title: VER 1-1 FRO | Verona v Frosinone 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' The game is interrupted as Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone) is flagged offside.
90+2' Tomas Suslov (Verona) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
90+1' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) replaces Matias Soule.
89' Thomas Henry (Verona) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ruben Vinagre (Verona) comes onto the pitch so that Juan David Cabal can be given a rest.

88' A cross is whipped in towards Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
86' Juan David Cabal (Verona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
82' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Kaio Jorge and he is replaced by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone).
82' A substitution has been made. Abdou Harroui is replaced by Reinier (Frosinone).
81' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Ondrej Duda will be replaced by Daniel Silva (Verona).
81' Substitution. Juan Manuel Cruz (Verona) on for Tijjani Noslin.
77' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
76' Frosinone quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

76' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Frosinone are going to take it.
73' Federico La Penna blows the whistle, Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is penalised for a foul. It's a free kick to Frosinone, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
70' Substitution. Demba Seck is replaced by Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone).

70' That didn't go as planned! Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Lorenzo Montipo, who easily kept it out.
69' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

68' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) meets a cross on the edge of the box and produces a header towards the left side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Frosinone.
68' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

65' Elayis Tavsan (Verona) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Stefano Turati pulls off an easy save.

65' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
63' Here is a change. Suat Serdar is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Elayis Tavsan (Verona).
63' A substitution has been made. Darko Lazovic goes off and Thomas Henry (Verona) comes on.
63' A clever short pass gives Tomas Suslov (Verona) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.

58' 1 - 1 Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the left side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
58' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
58' Demba Seck (Frosinone) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Frosinone earn a corner.
58' A quickly taken corner by Frosinone.

58' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. The ball is out of play. Frosinone win a corner kick.
56' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the bottom left corner and Lorenzo Montipo easily makes the save.
56' Frosinone work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
56' Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Frosinone will take a corner kick.
54' A pass by Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
54' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.

50' Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Lorenzo Montipo makes a great save.
49' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
46' Eusebio Di Francesco has made a change at the break. Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone) has come on in place of Mehdi Bourabia.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Suat Serdar (Verona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45+2' 1 - 0 Goal! Tomas Suslov (Verona) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Stefano Turati into the top left corner.
45+2' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+2' Referee Federico La Penna is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Verona!
45+2' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Verona as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
45+1' Mehdi Bourabia (Frosinone) handles the ball inside the penalty area. A penalty is awarded to Verona!
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Ondrej Duda (Verona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
45' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tijjani Noslin (Verona). The linesman makes the right call and Verona will have a corner.
43' Mehdi Bourabia (Frosinone) makes a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
41' Verona have been awarded a free kick. An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone). Federico La Penna saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.

37' A rebound falls to Darko Lazovic (Verona) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
37' Stefano Turati anticipates the direction of the penalty by Ondrej Duda (Verona). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
37' Ondrej Duda (Verona) is going to take the penalty!
36' The Verona players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
35' There's a break in play and referee Federico La Penna must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Verona using VAR. This could be interesting!
35' PENALTY APPEAL after Tijjani Noslin (Verona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
34' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Verona will have a chance to score from a corner.
34' Darko Lazovic (Verona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
31' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
28' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
27' Wasted opportunity. Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
27' Lorenzo Montipo leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Francesco Gelli (Frosinone).
26' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Francesco Gelli (Frosinone), but one of the defenders gets it clear. Frosinone win a corner.
26' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Now Frosinone have a corner.
23' Demba Seck (Frosinone) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
20' Darko Lazovic (Verona) is caught offside!
19' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
19' Wow, what an escape. Demba Seck (Frosinone) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Frosinone will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
18' Darko Lazovic (Verona) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
15' Demba Seck (Frosinone) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
14' Verona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
12' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Michael Folorunsho (Verona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
10' Tomas Suslov (Verona) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Stefano Turati makes a comfortable save.
9' Tomas Suslov (Verona) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
7' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
6' Demba Seck (Frosinone) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
3' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Verona will have the kick-off.
Federico La Penna got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
